responsibility: This file provides core construction, copying, destruction, and validation logic for gfc_expr trees, the central expression data structure of the Fortran front end. It allocates constants, operators, array and structure constructors, characters and null expressions; deep-copies expressions, shapes, refs, and associated metadata; and performs context checks such as variable-definition legality, intent/protection restrictions, and vector-subscript constraints that are shared across parsing, resolution, simplification, and initialization handling.
